pairs: to transfer, to carry, to transport (somewhere)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: перехо́д — passage; перемени́ть — (transitive) to change; перее́хать — to move (to change residence); переноси́ть — to transfer, to carry, to transport (somewhere).

**провёл** — провести́ (perfective): to lead, to conduct, to guide, to steer, to take; to lay, to construct, to build, to install a road, a pipe, a wire etc.; to carry out, to carry through, to realize, to put into practice, to conduct; to pass over, to run over. Wiktionary: про- + вести.
